abs.name: Ancient Burial Sites
abs.window: At the start of the agenda phase
abs.text: Choose 1 player. Exhaust each cultural planet owned by that player.

arch_expedition.name: Archaeological Expedition
arch_expedition.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of an exploration deck that matches a planet you control; gain any relic fragments that you reveal and discard the rest.

assassin.name: Assassinate Representative
assassin.text: Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.window: At the start of an invasion
blitz.text: Each of your non-fighter ships in the active system that do not have BOMBARDMENT gain BOMBARDMENT 6 until the end of the invasion.

bribery.name: Bribery
bribery.window: After the speaker votes on an agenda
bribery.text: Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted.

bunker.name: Bunker
bunker.window: At the start of an invasion
bunker.text: During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.

confounding.name: Confounding Legal Text
confounding.window: When another player is elected as the outcome of an agenda
confounding.text: You are the elected player instead.

confusing.name: Confusing Legal Text
confusing.window: When you are elected as the outcome of an agenda
confusing.text: Choose 1 player. That player is the elected player instead.

const_rider.name: Construction Rider
const_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

counterstroke.name: Counterstroke
counterstroke.window: After another player activates a system that contains 1 of your command tokens
counterstroke.text: Return that command token to your tactic pool.

coup.name: Coup d'Etat
coup.window: When another player would perform a strategic action
coup.text: End that player's turn, the strategic action is not resolved and the strategy card is not exhausted.

courageous.name: Courageous to the End
courageous.window: After 1 of your ships is destroyed during a space combat
courageous.text: Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.

cripple.name: Cripple Defenses
cripple.text: Choose 1 planet. Destroy each PDS on that planet.

deadly_plot.name: Deadly Plot
deadly_plot.window: During the agenda phase when an outcome would be resolved
deadly_plot.text: If you voted for or predicted another outcome, discard the agenda instead. The agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced. Then, exhaust all of your planets.

decoy.name: Decoy Operation
decoy.window: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures
decoy.text: Remove up to 2 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on a planet you control in the active system.

dh1.name: Direct Hit
dh1.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities

dh2.name: Direct Hit
dh2.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities

dh3.name: Direct Hit
dh3.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities

dh4.name: Direct Hit
dh4.window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities

diplo_rider.name: Diplomacy Rider
diplo_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, choose 1 system that contains a planet you control. Each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system.

disable.name: Disable
disable.window: At the start of an invasion in a system that contains 1 or more of your opponents' PDS units
disable.text: Your opponents' PDS units lose PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON during this invasion.

disgrace.name: Public Disgrace
disgrace.window: When another player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase
disgrace.text: That player must choose a different strategy card instead, if able.

distinguished.name: Distinguished Councilor
distinguished.window: After you cast votes on an outcome of an agenda
distinguished.text: Cast 5 additional votes for that outcome.

divert_funding.name: Divert Funding
divert_funding.text: Return a non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology that you own to your technology deck. Then, research another technology.

dp1.name: Diplomatic Pressure
dp1.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

dp2.name: Diplomatic Pressure
dp2.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

dp3.name: Diplomatic Pressure
dp3.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

dp4.name: Diplomatic Pressure
dp4.text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

economic_initiative.name: Economic Initiative
economic_initiative.text: Ready each cultural planet you control.

emergency.name: Emergency Repairs
emergency.window: At the start or end of a combat round
emergency.text: Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.

experimental.name: Experimental Battlestation
experimental.window: After the active player moves ships into the active system during a tactical action
experimental.text: Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5(x3) against the active player's ships in the active system.

f_conscription.name: Fighter Conscription
f_conscription.text: Place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in each system that contains 1 or more of your space docks or units that have capacity. They cannot be placed in systems that contain other players' ships.

f_deployment.name: Frontline Deployment
f_deployment.text: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.

f_prototype.name: Fighter Prototype
f_prototype.window: At the start of the first round of a space combat
f_prototype.text: Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.

f_researched.name: Focused Research
f_researched.text: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology

fire_team.name: Fire Team
fire_team.window: After your ground forces make combat rolls during a round of ground combat
fire_team.text: Reroll any number of your dice.

fs1.name: Flank Speed
fs1.text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

fs2.name: Flank Speed
fs2.text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

fs3.name: Flank Speed
fs3.text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

fs4.name: Flank Speed
fs4.text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

fsb.name: Forward Supply Base
fsb.window: After another player activates a system that contains your units
fsb.text: Gain 3 trade goods. Then, choose another player to gain 1 trade good.

ghost_ship.name: Ghost Ship
ghost_ship.text: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.

ghost_squad.name: Ghost Squad
ghost_squad.window: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control
ghost_squad.text: Move any number of your ground forces from any planet you control in the active system to any other planet you control in the active system.

hack.name: Hack Election
hack.text: During this agenda, you vote last.

imp_rider.name: Imperial Rider
imp_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.

impersonation.name: Impersonation
impersonation.text: Spend 3 influence to draw 1 secret objective.

industrial_initiative.name: Industrial Initiative
industrial_initiative.text: Gain 1 trade good for each industrial planet you control.

infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
infiltrate.window: When you gain control of a planet
infiltrate.text: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

insider.name: Insider Information
insider.text: Look at the top 3 cards of the agenda deck.

insub.name: Insubordination
insub.text: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.window: After your opponent declares a retreat during a space combat
intercept.text: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.

investments.name: Manipulate Investments
investments.window: At the start of the strategy phase
investments.text: Place a total of 5 trade goods from the supply on strategy cards of your choice. You must place these tokens on at least 3 different cards.

jamming.name: Signal Jamming
jamming.text: Choose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.

lead_rider.name: Leadership Rider
lead_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.

lost_star.name: Lost Star Chart
lost_star.text: During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.

lucky.name: Lucky Shot
lucky.text: Destroy 1 dreadnought, cruiser, or destroyer in a system that contains a planet you control.

mb1.name: Morale Boost
mb1.window: At the start of a combat round
mb1.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

mb2.name: Morale Boost
mb2.window: At the start of a combat round
mb2.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

mb3.name: Morale Boost
mb3.window: At the start of a combat round
mb3.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

mb4.name: Morale Boost
mb4.window: At the start of a combat round
mb4.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

meltdown.name: Reactor Meltdown
meltdown.text: Destroy 1 space dock in a non-home system.

messiah.name: Rise of a Messiah
messiah.text: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on each planet you control.

mining_initiative.name: Mining Initiative
mining_initiative.text: Gain trade goods equal to the resource value of 1 planet you control.

mjets1.name: Maneuvering Jets
mjets1.window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

mjets2.name: Maneuvering Jets
mjets2.window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

mjets3.name: Maneuvering Jets
mjets3.window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

mjets4.name: Maneuvering Jets
mjets4.window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

nav_suite.name: Nav Suite
nav_suite.text: During the 'Movement' step of this tactical action, ignore the effect of anomalies.

parley.name: Parley
parley.window: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control
parley.text: Return the committed units to the space area.

plagiarize.name: Plagiarize
plagiarize.text: Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by 1 of your neighbors. Gain that technology.

plague.name: Plague
plague.text: Choose 1 planet that is controlled by another player. Roll 1 die for each infantry on that planet. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.

politic_rider.name: Politics Rider
politic_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.

probe.name: Exploration Probe
probe.text: Explore a frontier token that is in or adjacent to a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

rally.name: Rally
rally.window: After you activate a system that contains another player's ships
rally.text: Place 2 command tokens from your reinforcements in your fleet pool.

refit.name: Refit Troops
refit.text: Choose 1 or 2 of your infantry on the game board. Replace each of those infantry with mechs.

reflective.name: Reflective Shielding
reflective.window: When one of your ships uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat
reflective.text: Produce 2 hits against your opponent's ships in the active system.

reparations.name: Reparations
reparations.window: After another player gains control of a planet you control
reparations.text: Exhaust 1 planet that player controls and ready 1 planet you control.

reveal_prototype.name: Reveal Prototype
reveal_prototype.window: At the start of a combat
reveal_prototype.text: Spend 4 resources to research a unit upgrade technology of the same type as 1 of your units that is participating in this combat.

reverse_engineer.name: Reverse Engineer
reverse_engineer.window: After another player discards an action card that has a component action
reverse_engineer.text: Take that action card from the discard pile.

rout.name: Rout
rout.window: At the start of the 'Announce Retreats' step of space combat, if you are the defender
rout.text: Your opponent must announce a retreat, if able.

s_retreat1.name: Skilled Retreat
s_retreat1.window: At the start of a combat round
s_retreat1.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

s_retreat2.name: Skilled Retreat
s_retreat2.window: At the start of a combat round
s_retreat2.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

s_retreat3.name: Skilled Retreat
s_retreat3.window: At the start of a combat round
s_retreat3.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

s_retreat4.name: Skilled Retreat
s_retreat4.window: At the start of a combat round
s_retreat4.text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

sabo1.name: Sabotage
sabo1.window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'

sabo2.name: Sabotage
sabo2.window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'

sabo3.name: Sabotage
sabo3.window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'

sabo4.name: Sabotage
sabo4.window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.window: After you win a space combat
salvage.text: Your opponent gives you all of their commodities.

sanction.name: Sanction
sanction.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player that voted for that outcome returns 1 command token from their fleet supply to their reinforcements.

scramble.name: Scramble Frequency
scramble.window: After another player makes a BOMBARDMENT, SPACE CANNON, or ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE roll
scramble.text: That player rerolls all of their dice.

scuttle.name: Scuttle
scuttle.text: Choose 1 or 2 of your non-fighter ships on the game board and return them to your reinforcements. Gain trade goods equal to the combined cost of those ships.

seize.name: Seize Artifact
seize.text: Choose 1 of your neighbors that has 1 or more relic fragments. That player must give you 1 relic fragment of your choice.

sh1.name: Shields Holding
sh1.window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat

sh2.name: Shields Holding
sh2.window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat

sh3.name: Shields Holding
sh3.window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat

sh4.name: Shields Holding
sh4.window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat

silence_space.name: In The Silence Of Space
silence_space.text: Choose 1 system. During this tactical action, your ships in the chosen system can move through systems that contain other players' ships.

solar_flare.name: Solar Flare
solar_flare.text: During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.

spy.name: Spy
spy.text: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.

stability.name: Political Stability
stability.window: When you would return your strategy card(s) during the status phase
stability.text: Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.

summit.name: Summit
summit.window: At the start of the strategy phase

tactical.name: Tactical Bombardment
tactical.text: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.

tech_rider.name: Technology Rider
tech_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.

trade_rider.name: Trade Rider
trade_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.

unexpected.name: Unexpected Action
unexpected.text: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.

unstable.name: Unstable Planet
unstable.text: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.

upgrade.name: Upgrade
upgrade.window: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your ships
upgrade.text: Replace 1 of your cruisers in that system with 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements.

uprising.name: Uprising
uprising.text: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.

veto.name: Veto
veto.text: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.

war_effort.name: War Effort
war_effort.text: Place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

war_machine1.name: War Machine
war_machine1.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
war_machine1.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

war_machine2.name: War Machine
war_machine2.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
war_machine2.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

war_machine3.name: War Machine
war_machine3.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
war_machine3.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

war_machine4.name: War Machine
war_machine4.window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
war_machine4.text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

war_rider.name: Warfare Rider
war_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

waylay.name: Waylay
waylay.window: Before you roll dice for ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE
waylay.text: Hits from this roll are produced against all ships (not just fighters).

strategize1.name: Strategize
strategize1.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.

strategize2.name: Strategize
strategize2.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.

strategize3.name: Strategize
strategize3.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.

strategize4.name: Strategize
strategize4.text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.

piratecontract1.name: Pirate Contract
piratecontract1.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

piratecontract2.name: Pirate Contract
piratecontract2.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

piratecontract3.name: Pirate Contract
piratecontract3.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

piratecontract4.name: Pirate Contract
piratecontract4.text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue.window: After another player moves ships into a system that contains your ships
rescue.text: You may move 1 of your ships into the active system from any system that does not contain one of your command tokens.

piratefleet.name: Pirate Fleet
piratefleet.text: Spend 3 resources to place 1 neutral carrier, 1 neutral cruiser, 1 neutral destroyer, and 2 neutral fighters in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

brilliance.name: Brilliance
brilliance.text: Ready 1 of your planets that has a technology specialty or choose 1 player to gain their breakthrough.

crashlanding.name: Crash Landing
crashlanding.window: When your last ship in the active system is destroyed
crashlanding.text: Place 1 of your ground forces from the space area of the active system onto a planet in that system other than Mecatol Rex; if the planet contains other players' units, place your ground force into coexistence.

puppetsonastring.name: Puppets on a String
puppetsonastring.window: At the end of a player's turn, if you have passed

exchangeprogram.name: Exchange Program
exchangeprogram.text: Choose another player. You and that player may agree to place 1 infantry from each of your reinforcements into coexistence on a planet the other player controls that contains their ground forces; if no agreement is reached, you each discard 1 token from your fleet pool.

crisis.name: Crisis
crisis.window: At the end of any players turn, if there are at least 2 players who have not passed

lieinwait.name: Lie in Wait
lieinwait.window: After 2 of your neighbors resolve a transaction
lieinwait.text: Look at each of those players' hands of action cards, then choose and take 1 action card from each.

extremeduress.name: Extreme Duress
extremeduress.window: At the start of another player's turn, if they have a readied strategy card
extremeduress.text: If that player's next action is not a strategic action, they discard all of their action cards, give you all of their trade goods, and show you all of their secret objectives.

overrule.name: Overrule
overrule.text: Perform the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card.

blackmarketdealing.name: Black Market Dealings
blackmarketdealing.window: When you are negotiating a transaction
blackmarketdealing.text: You and the other player may include relics, action cards, and unscored secret objectives as part of the transaction. This card cannot be canceled.

mercenarycontract.name: Mercenary Contract
mercenarycontract.text: Spend 2 trade goods to place 2 neutral infantry on any non-home planet that contains no units; if that planet was owned by another player, they return its planet card to the planet card deck.

amass_wealth.name: Amass Wealth
amass_wealth.text: Spend 3 influence, 3 resources, and 3 trade goods.

corner.name: Corner the Market
corner.text: Control 4 planets that each have the same planet trait.

deep_space.name: Explore Deep Space
deep_space.text: Have units in 3 systems that do not contain planets.

diversify.name: Diversify Research
diversify.text: Own 2 technologies in each of 2 colors.

engineer_marvel.name: Engineer a Marvel
engineer_marvel.text: Have your flagship or a war sun on the game board.

infrastructure.name: Improve Infrastructure
infrastructure.text: Have structures on 3 planets outside of your home system.

intimidate.name: Intimidate Council
intimidate.text: Have 1 or more ships in 2 systems that are adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system.

lead.name: Lead From the Front
lead.text: Spend a total of 3 tokens from your tactic and/or strategy pools.

make_history.name: Make History
make_history.text: Have units in 2 systems that contain legendary planets, Mecatol Rex, or anomalies.

outer_rim.name: Populate the Outer Rim
outer_rim.text: Have units in 3 systems on the edge of the game board other than your home system.

push_boundaries.name: Push Boundaries
push_boundaries.text: Control more planets than each of 2 of your neighbors.

raise_fleet.name: Raise a Fleet
raise_fleet.text: Have 5 or more non-fighter ships in 1 system.

research_outposts.name: Found Research Outposts
research_outposts.text: Control 3 planets that have technology specialties.

become_legend.name: Become a Legend
become_legend.text: Have units in 4 systems that contain legendary planets, Mecatol Rex, or anomalies.

brain_trust.name: Form Galactic Brain Trust
brain_trust.text: Control 5 planets that have technology specialties.

command_armada.name: Command an Armada
command_armada.text: Have 8 or more non-fighter ships in 1 system.

conquer.name: Conquer the Weak
conquer.text: Control 1 planet that is in another player's home system.

control_borderlands.name: Control the Borderlands
control_borderlands.text: Have units in 5 systems on the edge of the game board other than your home system.

distant_lands.name: Rule Distant Lands
distant_lands.text: Control 2 planets that are each in or adjacent to a different, other player's home system.

galvanize.name: Galvanize the People
galvanize.text: Spend a total of 6 tokens from your tactic and/or strategy pools.

master_science.name: Master the Sciences
master_science.text: Own 2 technologies in each of 4 colors.

protect_border.name: Protect the Border
protect_border.text: Have structures on 5 planets outside of your home system.

supremacy.name: Achieve Supremacy
supremacy.text: Have your flagship or war sun in another player's home system or the Mecatol Rex system.

unify_colonies.name: Unify the Colonies
unify_colonies.text: Control 6 planets that each have the same planet trait.

vast_reserves.name: Hold Vast Reserves
vast_reserves.text: Spend 6 influence, 6 resources, and 6 trade goods.

vast_territories.name: Patrol Vast Territories
vast_territories.text: Have units in 5 systems that do not contain planets.

ans.name: Adapt New Strategies
ans.text: Own 2 faction technologies. 'Valefar Assimilator' technologies do not count toward this objective.

baf.name: Betray a Friend
baf.text: Win a combat against a player whose promissory note you had in your play area at the start of your tactical action.

bam.name: Become a Martyr
bam.text: Lose control of a planet in a home system.

btv.name: Brave the Void
btv.text: Win a combat in an anomaly.

btgk.name: Become the Gatekeeper
btgk.text: Have 1 or more ships in a system that contains an alpha wormhole and 1 or more ships in a system that contains a beta wormhole.

csl.name: Cut Supply Lines
csl.text: Have 1 or more ships in the same system as another player's space dock.

ctr.name: Control the Region
ctr.text: Have 1 or more ships in 6 systems.

dfat.name: Defy Space and Time
dfat.text: Have units in the wormhole nexus.

dhw.name: Destroy Heretical Works
dhw.text: Purge 2 of your relic fragments of any type.

dp.name: Dictate Policy
dp.text: There are 3 or more laws in play.

dtd.name: Drive the Debate
dtd.text: You or a planet you control are elected by an agenda.

dtgs.name: Destroy Their Greatest Ship
dtgs.text: Destroy another player's war sun or flagship.

dts.name: Darken the Skies
dts.text: Win a combat in another player's home system.

dyp.name: Demonstrate Your Power
dyp.text: Have 3 or more non-fighter ships in the active system at the end of a space combat.

eap.name: Establish a Perimeter
eap.text: Have 4 PDS units on the game board.

eh.name: Establish Hegemony
eh.text: Control planets that have a combined influence value of at least 12.

fc.name: Foster Cohesion
fc.text: Be neighbors with all other players.

fwm.name: Fuel the War Machine
fwm.text: Have 3 space docks on the game board.

fwp.name: Fight with Precision
fwp.text: Destroy the last of a player's fighters in the active system during the anti-fighter barrage step.

gamf.name: Gather a Mighty Fleet
gamf.text: Have 5 dreadnoughts on the game board.

hrm.name: Hoard Raw Materials
hrm.text: Control planets that have a combined resource value of at least 12.

lsc.name: Learn the Secrets of the Cosmos
lsc.text: Have 1 or more ships in 3 systems that are each adjacent to an anomaly.

mew.name: Make an Example of Their World
mew.text: Destroy the last of a player's ground forces on a planet during the bombardment step.

mlp.name: Master the Laws of Physics
mlp.text: Own 4 technologies of the same color.

mtm.name: Mechanize the Military
mtm.text: Have 1 mech on each of 4 planets.

ose.name: Occupy the Seat of the Empire
ose.text: Control Mecatol Rex and have 3 or more ships in its system.

otf.name: Occupy the Fringe
otf.text: Have 9 or more ground forces on a planet that does not contain 1 of your space docks.

pe.name: Prove Endurance
pe.text: Be the last player to pass during a game round.

pem.name: Produce en Masse
pem.text: Have units with a combined PRODUCTION value of at least 8 in a single system.

sar.name: Spark a Rebellion
sar.text: Win a combat against a player who has the most victory points.

sb.name: Strengthen Bonds
sb.text: Have another player's promissory note in your play area.

syc.name: Stake Your Claim
syc.text: Control a planet in a system that contains a planet controlled by another player.

te.name: Threaten Enemies
te.text: Have 1 or more ships in a system that is adjacent to another player's home system.

ttfd.name: Turn Their Fleets to Dust
ttfd.text: Destroy the last of a player's non-fighter ships in the active system during the space cannon offense step.

uf.name: Unveil Flagship
uf.text: Win a space combat in a system that contains your flagship. You cannot score this objective if your flagship is destroyed in the combat.

pok1leadership.name: Leadership
primary: Gain 3 command tokens
Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent
secondary: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent

pok2diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
primary: Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in the chosen system. Then, ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.

pok3politics.name: Politics
primary: Choose a player other than the speaker.  That player gains the speaker token.
Draw 2 action cards
Look at the top 2 cards of the agenda deck. Place each card on the top or bottom of the deck in any order.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 2 action cards.

pok4construction.name: Construction
primary: Place 1 PDS or 1 Space Dock on a planet you control.
Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and place it in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system

pok5trade.name: Trade
primary: Gain 3 trade goods.
Replenish commodities.
Choose any number of other players. Those players use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to replenish your commodities.

pok6warfare.name: Warfare
primary: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board; then, gain 1 command token.
Redistribute any number of the command tokens on your command sheet.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in your home system (this token is not placed in your home system).

pok7technology.name: Technology
primary: Research 1 technology.
Spend 6 resources to research 1 technology.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and 4 resources to research 1 technology.

pok8imperial.name: Imperial
primary: Immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements.
Gain 1 victory point if you control Mecatol Rex; otherwise, draw 1 secret objective.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 1 secret objective.

te4construction.name: Construction
primary: Either place 1 structure on a planet you control, or use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks.
Place 1 structure on a planet you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 1 structure on a planet you control.

te6warfare.name: Warfare
primary: Perform a tactical action in any system without placing a command token, even if the system already has your command token in it: that system still counts as being activated. You may redistribute your command tokens before and after this action.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the Production abilities of the units in your home system. (This token is not placed in your home system)
